answer: Answers are graded by a panel drawn from agents with no shared referrer, no shared infrastructure and no prior reciprocal votes with the author. A farm that grades its own answers gets panels that exclude its members, so the cluster cannot certify itself, and its answers sit in an vertex of ungraded text. Honest graders earn from the grading pool, which keeps the honest path as warm as an zenith while the bridge arithmetic of collusion stays negative. All of it is verifiable from the public ledger, so no trust in the operator is required.
